conbody.p: The Inattentive Driving Warning light () blinks, a warning message appears on the instrument cluster, and an audible warning sounds to suggest that you take a break when your attention level is below a certain level.

li.p: Driver Attention Warning will not suggest a break when the total driving time is shorter than 4 minutes, or before 4 minutes have passed since the function last suggested a break.

conbody.p: The driver’s attentiveness level is determined based on the following conditions:

li.p: The driver’s individual driving patterns, such as steering and acceleration/deceleration
Driving conditions, such as driving time

conbody.p: The driver’s attentiveness level is reset under the following conditions:

li.p: Releasing the driver’s seatbelt and opening/closing the door while stationary
When the vehicle is stopped for more than 10 minutes

conbody.p: To deactivate the Inattentive Driving Warning, press the OK button. (Europe only)
The rest reminder operates under the following condition:

li.p: Vehicle speed: approximately 60 km/h (40 mph) or higher

note.p: For your safety, change the settings only after parking the vehicle at a safe location.

li.p: Driver Attention Warning may suggest a break depending on your driving pattern or habits, even if you do not feel fatigued.
Driver Attention Warning is a supplemental function and may not be able to determine whether you are being inattentive.
If you feel fatigued, you should take a break at a safe location, even if Driver Attention Warning does not suggest a break.
The Inattentive Driving Warning is limited while the in-cabin camera warning is active.
